_what: The studio's libraries. Each is copied into every new game at creation under studio/, and `npm run sweep` brings every existing game forward; the version a game holds is recorded in its studio/studio.json. Bump `version` when the files change — the compatibility law (spec.md §4) says the new version must run every game the old one ran. `files` are the library's own, read-only to helpers; `seeds` are the game's own companion files, written once and never replaced.

input.what: One way in for the keyboard, a game controller and a touchscreen, for one player or two.

sound.what: Plays the sounds in assets/sounds/ with one call — overlapping shots, loops, mute — and never breaks the game over a missing file.

sprites.what: Draws the pictures in assets/sprites/ by name, animated when the picture is a film strip of square frames, and never breaks the game over a missing one.

screens.what: A phone-fit title and game-over screen, a HUD strip of score chips, and a one-line how-to-play hint worked out from config/controls.js and the device — keys on a keyboard, the touch scheme's own shape on a phone, controller buttons when one is plugged in.
